name: CompareObjectsForSort
evidence: comparator of two object pointers on 0x304, then 0x308, then bit 38 of the flags, then 0x2D0

name: UploadLightVolumes
evidence: sorts the world's cone volumes (its list at +0x1BE8) into g_sortedLights with CompareObjectsForSort, splits them into at most 16 runs in g_lightGroups and sends their shapes to VU0 memory through the VIF0 channel; func_0019DC98 calls it each frame

name: CollectLightsForSphere
evidence: tests a sphere (a point and a radius) against every light group of g_lightGroups on VU0 (microprograms at 0x60 and 0x168 by the group's kind) and writes the lights that reach it, up to a maximum, with their count and the strongest +0x2D4 mode; SelectVertexBatchLights and DrawModelPart call it

name: InitAim
evidence: sets the aim record's field 0x20 to -1, 0x40 to 800.0, copies the vectors D_00264770..D_002647A0 and sets 0x44 and 0x48

name: AssignAimTarget
evidence: stores the object and a point as the target (hasTarget 1), or clears the target when the object is null or is the active collider

name: ResolveAimTarget
evidence: returns the aim's target, or the active switched collider when it has none

name: SwitchAimByTargetDistance
evidence: slot 3 of the aim's table D_0021A790: picks +0x48 when the target (ResolveAimTarget) is farther than +0x40 from the owner, else +0x44 after ClearRootTries, and when that changes the value at +0x14 re-sorts the owner's attachments (SortAttachments)

name: GetAimRotation
evidence: slot 5 of the aim's table D_0021A790: the owner's rotation (+0xD0 with flag +0x4C, or +0x1A0 when the target is within +0x40), else a yaw and pitch matrix (GetVectorAngles, BuildYawPitchMatrix) towards the target (ResolveAimTarget)

name: RunMainLoop
evidence: after startup it loops forever: updates the fade, pad, memory card and menus each frame and runs the world's update and draw

name: LoadIopModules
evidence: loads the IOP image ioprp243.img and the six modules named in D_002647A8 one by one

name: SendVif0StartupPacket
evidence: a startup initializer (D_00264814, run by RunStartupInitializers): sets bit 0x40 of the VIF0 channel's control word, sends the packet D_00211E10 on it, waits and clears the bit

name: SendVif1StartupPacket
evidence: a startup initializer (D_00264818, run by RunStartupInitializers): sets bit 0x40 of the VIF1 channel's control word, sends the packet D_00212110 on it, waits and clears the bit

name: RunStartupInitializers
evidence: calls each of the 29 functions of D_002647C0 in order while updating the progress bar with UpdateLoadProgress
